intent: Bring code_tutor/_analyzer.py under the 250-line cap by separating the import-graph half and the static scan tables, with no behaviour change.
scope: Non-goal: no assertion changed, no test deleted, skipped or weakened
changes: Moved get_python_files, _build_dotted_map, _match_deps, get_file_imports and codebase_fingerprint into _deps.py, which imports _should_skip back from _analyzer and owns the hashlib import it was the only user of.

Moved the _SKIP_DIRS, _SKIP_SUFFIXES and _OTHER_LANGS frozensets and the _FUNCTION_RE pattern into _scan_tables.py. The first cut left _analyzer.py at 259, nine over; these tables are pure data with no patch targets, which made them the cheapest remaining lines.
cli.py and _plan_builder.py import the moved functions from _deps directly. test_analyzer.py's single import block was split across the two modules.
_is_binary is the only name any test patches on _analyzer, and it stays there, so no patch string in the package needed editing - a much cheaper seam than the _challenge one.

verification.command: timeout 90 env PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/code_tutor/tests -q
verification.evidence: 216 passed in 2.2s - identical to the baseline count, and inside the timeout that the previous commit's hang made standard here.

verification.command: timeout 90 env PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/code_tutor/tests -q (first run)
verification.evidence: One collection ImportError: test_analyzer.py imports _build_dotted_map and four other moved names from _analyzer. Its import block was split across the two modules and the run returned to 216.

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from python_pkg.code_tutor import _analyzer as a, _deps as d, cli, _plan_builder as pb, _scan_tables as t; a._is_binary; a._SKIP_DIRS; a._FUNCTION_RE; d.get_file_imports; d._should_skip; d.hashlib; cli.codebase_fingerprint; pb.get_python_files"
verification.evidence: all patch targets resolve - including cli.codebase_fingerprint, which three test_cli.py patches name and which still resolves because cli imports it from its new home.
226, 145 and 48 lines, all under the 250-line cap.

verification.command: pre-commit run --files <the touched files and artifacts>
verification.evidence: ruff auto-sorted six import statements across the new and edited modules; clean on re-run, and pytest-with-coverage passes.

risks: _analyzer <- _deps and _analyzer <- _scan_tables must stay one-way; _analyzer importing from _deps would be a cycle, and _deps already imports _should_skip from _analyzer.
The scan tables are now two modules away from the extraction code that reads them, so a future skip-list change has to be made in _scan_tables rather than where it is used.
rollback: git revert the commit; _analyzer.py returns to 388 lines and the two new modules disappear.
After rollback, re-run the package suite and confirm it still reports 216 passed.
